order: Call the eligibility helper with the instance/group key before reading or changing points.
Compute points minus cost using 32-bit wrapping subtraction.
Reject a nonzero cost when the resulting word has its sign bit set; cost zero bypasses that sign test.
Store the wrapped remaining points at manager+0x6d70 only after the cost guard passes.
Call status operator[] on manager+0x4d00; create a missing status entry with a zero byte.
OR the status byte with 0x03, preserving every bit outside 0x01 and 0x02, including SDK NotUnlockable bit 0x04.
Append the unchanged two-word key to manager+0x6d80 without a duplicate check.
eligibility: If a status entry exists, the helper returns status & 0x01; the target rejects an already Unlocked item when that bit is set.
If no status entry exists and the configured map contains the key, the helper returns zero and the target proceeds.
If neither map contains the key, the helper returns manager+0x0c; the target proceeds only when that byte is zero.
The live helper does not test status bit 0x04. The SDK NotUnlockable bit is covered as a preserved status bit rather than assigned a speculative rejection rule.
cost_edges: cost 0 permits a negative points word because the live TEST cost branch skips the sign check
positive cost rejects a wrapped negative remaining word before any debit or status creation
negative cost is subtracted as a wrapped signed word and can increase points
INT32_MIN with zero points wraps to a negative remaining word and is rejected
